long_description:
11:11 Portal to new beginnings... higher consciousness. Take 71 minutes to bask in the Divine nectar within your heart. It's True Nature is bliss, ecstasy and a deep sense of fulfilment. A Multi Cultural event, no experience needed, love offering. Consciously connecting to sacred blessings as we elevate our consiousness to align with Divine frequencies. Please join us for a devotional Kirtan and Blessing Circle at Center for Awakening. Please join us, all are welcome. Love offering. goes to CFA Youth Outreach. 

Also check out other Bhajan jamming events in Midvale.
